## power-automate-mcp 1.2.1

- Updated references/tool-reference.md for improved or corrected tool documentation.
- No changes to functionality or code; documentation update only.

**Major refactor: separates foundation from workflow logic, introduces meta-tooling for modular skill loading.**

- Skill is now explicitly the foundational "plumbing" layer: sets up authentication, provides reusable MCP helpers in Python/Node, and handles tool/schema discovery.
- Workflow intent is now delegated to four specialized skills: `power-automate-build`, `power-automate-debug`, `power-automate-monitoring`, and `power-automate-governance`.
- Adds documentation and examples for new meta-tools: `list_skills` and `tool_search` to enable intent-based and selective tool loading (instead of loading all tools by default).
- Refreshed language on recommended usage patterns, emphasizing task-driven skill selection and concrete debugging references.
- Updates core helper implementations and clarifies recommended environments (Python, Node.js).
- Removes most workflow-specific instructions—those now live in the specialized skills.
Add metadata.openclaw declaring FLOWSTUDIO_MCP_TOKEN env var requirement to resolve security scan flag

- Initial release of the power-automate-mcp skill.
- Connects to and operates Power Automate cloud flows through a FlowStudio MCP server.
- Supports tasks such as listing flows, reading flow definitions, checking run history, managing connections, resubmitting or canceling runs, and more.
- Offers both live (real-time Power Automate API) tools for all MCP subscribers and store (cached/enriched) tools for FlowStudio for Teams subscribers.
- Recommends using Python or Node.js for seamless interaction with the MCP API.
- Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription and appropriate credentials for server access.
